role: OvernightStreamingCoordinator extension: starts overnight BLE streaming, runs the 1 Hz tick with incremental backup, merges resumed segments onto the parent, and runs the blocking morning stop (strap download + parallel sleep poll + analysis + finalize), including the streaming-short fallback.
types: selectBestDataSource: file-private func — morning source choice
OvernightDataResult.downloadedPoints: var [RRPoint]? (default nil) — the strap beats the gather downloaded

units.does: Returns true when the session's provenance model name contains 'verity' or 'sense'; with no provenance, true when the live connected device is a Verity Sense.

branches.effect: true: string match on model name ('verity' || 'sense'); false: live device type check

units.does: Builds a .failed HRVSession with the base id/start/type, publishes it as currentSession, moves the phase to .idle (nothing is analysed any more), sets lastError = insufficientData unless lastError already says the strap still holds this night (reportDeviceFetchMiss — kept, since lastError is cleared when a night or segment starts), clears morningStatus; returns it.
Whether an error is CollectorError.strapStillHoldsNight (any minutes).

branches.cond: not a CollectorError, or another case

units.does: Starts an overnight/nap streaming session: first refuses while an earlier night's ending is in progress (refuseWhileEndingInProgress, which also drops a stale claim), then requires a connected, non-streaming strap, creates the session with streaming provenance, records the capture choice, starts PolarManager streaming, and only then starts diagnostics sampling (a failed start leaves no sampler running), launches the H10 arming loop when backup is on and the device is not Verity Sense, resets state (clearing lastError), starts HealthKit sleep/vitals observers, persists recording state, logs and starts the 1 Hz timer.

branches.cond: an earlier night's ending is in progress

branches.effect: propagates before sampling or arming starts

branches.cond: useDeviceInternalBackup and device is not Verity Sense
branches.effect: launch arming loop; else streaming only

units.does: Resets collector state for a new overnight session: currentSession, empty points, start time, streaming/overnight/collecting flags, recordingPhase .overnightStreaming, unbounded target, counters zeroed, backup/ending flags cleared, deviceFetchPolicy .automatic, and lastError cleared (an earlier session's error is not this night's). The ending claim is not touched: the start already refused while one was held.
Starts HealthKit observers for sleep and vitals so Watch syncs trigger rescoring.
Warns about low strap battery and debug-logs the session start (backup mode, id, type, device id).
Invalidates any streaming timer and schedules a repeating 1 s Timer (tolerance 0.25 s) whose block hops to the main actor and runs overnightStreamingTick.

1 Hz tick: sets elapsed seconds to the wall clock since the session start (streamingElapsedNow), rechecks strap battery staleness on the first tick of each 30 s of that clock, detects a reconnect by comparing streamingReconnectCount, and runs the incremental backup (forced after a reconnect).
units.entry: Timer block scheduled by startOvernightStreamingTimer (1 Hz).

branches.cond: not overnight streaming or timer nil
elapsed crossed into a new 30 s block

branches.effect: log and record new count; backup forced

units.does: Calls RawRRBackup.incrementalBackup with the whole streamed buffer (internally throttled); when it wrote, uploads the buffer as a CloudKit live backup in a utility Task.

For a resumed child, loads the first linked (parent) session from the archive and prepends its beats to the child's beats offset onto the parent's clock, returning a base session re-anchored to the parent's start; otherwise returns the input unchanged.

branches.cond: no linked id, parent not found, or parent has no beats

units.does: Shifts the child's t_ms and wallClockMs by the ms offset between child start and parent start; nil when the offset is non-positive or unrepresentable.
Builds an .analyzing HRVSession with the child's id/type/provenance/links/pausedDate but the parent's startDate and the child's endDate (or now).
True when either source has >=120 beats, or for a resumed child when any beat exists.

Morning stop: claims the night's ending (StreamingLifecycle.claimOvernightEnding) before its first suspension, so a second Stop, or one landing while a pause or discard is ending the night, returns nil untouched; the claim is released once the night is on the review card or has failed (releaseEndingOnceShown, before the status hold and baseline update) and in any case on return, a no-op once released; from the tap, holds a background-task assertion from BackgroundTaskAssertion.forRecordingStop ("OvernightStop") until it returns and marks the persisted recording record stop-requested; ends arming, tears down streaming and publishes the saving state, backs up the beats, scores the night (scoreStoppedNight: the device-fetch fallback when streaming is short, else download/merge/score) and then disconnects a Verity Sense whichever way the night ended, unless a night has started on it since.

branches.cond: claim refused (not overnight streaming, or another caller is ending the night)

units.does: Scores a stopped night: with too little streaming (hasValidStreaming false) logs and takes fallbackToDeviceFetch; otherwise downloadMergeAndScoreNight. Returns the resulting session.
True when streamed beats >= 120, or the session is a resumed child with any beats.
Disconnects the strap when the night was a Verity Sense night and no overnight night is streaming on it since.

branches.cond: not Verity Sense, or a night is streaming again

units.does: Fetches the strap file and sleep concurrently, chooses the data source, then analyses and finalizes the night.
Runs the parallel HealthKit sleep poll (async let) while awaiting the strap download; returns both.
Returns the cached SleepData covering the recording when it has night sleep and plausibly overlaps the recording; else nil.

branches.cond: no cache entry, zero sleep, or implausible overlap

units.does: Sleep fast-path during the device fetch: cache hit returns at once; otherwise up to 3 HealthKit attempts 2 s apart (no wait after the last), aborting on protected-data errors.

branches.effect: each attempt, then 2 s sleep unless it was the last
break out of the loop, return nil

units.does: One HealthKit sleep fetch: found when nightSleepMinutes > 0, retry otherwise or on any error except HK errorDatabaseInaccessible, which aborts.

The single overnight strap-download gate: resets the transfer-cancel flag, returns nil (and stops any device recording) when Skip/streaming-only/Verity Sense or when the night never armed the strap and the strap reports no recording; otherwise reconnects and downloads the recording since the session start, honours a Skip tapped during the download, reports a failed read, and returns the strap beats on the night's clock. Always resets deviceFetchPolicy to .automatic and clears overnightDeviceBackupActive on exit (closeNightGate).

branches.cond: user tapped Skip during the download
branches.effect: stop device recording, return nil (downloaded data discarded)

units.does: Returns false (with a log line) when the user skipped, the capture mode is streaming-only, the device is a Verity Sense, or the night never armed the strap (overnightDeviceBackupActive false) and the strap reports no recording running; true otherwise.

branches.cond: night never armed the strap and the strap reports no recording
branches.effect: warning logged, false; else return true

units.does: Reconnects the strap for transfer (bounded); on success fetches the recording made since start and logs the timing.
After a failed strap read: if the stream's wall-clock gap is under 10 min logs an external note only; otherwise logs and sets lastError = strapStillHoldsNight(missingMinutes).
Minutes of wall clock the streamed beats do not cover: (last-first wallClockMs) − (last-first t_ms), floored at 0; 0 when the endpoints lack wall clock.

branches.cond: no points or endpoints lack wallClockMs

units.does: Stops timer and sampler, clears isStreamingMode before stopping streaming, captures base session/reconnect count/elapsed hours (streamingHoursForBattery: wall clock since the session start, tick count without one), stops PolarManager streaming and publishes the saving state; returns (base, beats, reconnects). Shared by the morning stop and the pause's gather.
Writes points to RawRRBackup on a detached utility task and awaits it; failure logged.

Merges any parent segment, publishes .analyzing, runs processOvernightData (foreground: publishes result and pre-archives), clears the recording marker once the night is saved (clearPersistedStateIfSaved), releases the stop's ending claim (releaseEndingOnceShown), shows .complete for 1 s then clears and updates the baseline tracker; returns the final session.

Clears the persisted recording marker unless the night is .complete and not in the archive (its pre-archive failed): then logs a warning and keeps the marker until Accept saves the night, so a crash on the review card still offers it at launch.
Releases the ending claim currently held (the stop's own, the only caller), once the stopped night is on the review card or shown as failed.
Sets morningStatus to the complete status, holds 1 s, clears it, and folds the session into BaselineTracker with the current sleep schedule.
Sleeps 1 s; a non-cancellation interruption is logged.

Streaming-short morning: downloads the strap file through the same gate; with fewer than 120 device beats (or none) fails the session (keeping a 'strap still holds the night' error the gate set) and clears the persisted recording marker, so the next launch does not offer the failed night as interrupted; else lets selectBestDataSource decide whether streaming fills the device recording's gaps and finalizes.

branches.effect: failSession, clear the recording marker, return the failed session

units.does: Fallback finalize: merges parent, publishes .analyzing, runs processOvernightData, clears the recording marker once the night is saved (clearPersistedStateIfSaved), sets currentSession, releases the stop's ending claim (releaseEndingOnceShown), then settles the morning status and updates the baseline.
Builds a DeviceProvenance for live streaming from the connected strap's id and display name.

Morning source choice: a device recording below DataSourceSelector.minimumValidBeats (or none) is not a source and streaming is used (deviceBeats nil); one at or above it always gets DataSourceSelector's choice, returned with deviceBeats = device count.

branches.cond: no device points, fewer than the minimum, or (never with enough points) no selection

units.does: Gate for a starting night or resumed segment: asks StreamingLifecycle.clearEndingForNewNight; returns when no ending claim is held; logs a warning with the claim's age in minutes and returns when a claim older than 30 min was dropped as left behind; logs and throws CollectorError.alreadyRecording, leaving the claim held, while an ending is still in progress.

branches.effect: warning logged with the claim's age; the start goes on

units.does: Resets the night's Skip (deviceFetchPolicy .automatic) and its arming flag (overnightDeviceBackupActive false) when the strap gate finishes.
